description:
Cause a noncreature artifact to enter the battlefield under your control, which will be an Equipment due to Dan Lewis if it isn't an Equipment already, causing Barret to trigger.
Resolve Barret's first ability, creating a 2/2 red Rebel creature token plus an additional artifact token through Peregrin Took, which will be an Equipment due to Dan Lewis. Each relevant ability of Barret triggers.
Repeat from step 2.
